scope: Single read-only sanitized native GNOME resident map attribution; no memory ownership mutation or renderer inference
limits: smaps and status/rollup are sequential kernel reads, not atomic
RSS charges shared mappings in full; PSS apportions shared pages
Heap anonymous page residency does not identify live allocations versus allocator slack
An old process snapshot is contextual only; source/toolkit/workload/uptime differ
No renderer inferred from library presence alone
